# RadioGroup
Radio Group - a set of Radio Group Items where exactly one is selected. Two Figma sets: Radio Group (545:98: Direction vertical | horizontal x Variant default | card, 4 variants) holds three Radio Group Item instances; Radio Group Item (544:283: Variant default | card x Checked unchecked | checked x Size sm | md x State default | hover | focus-visible | disabled | invalid, 40 variants, plus Label and Description switches and text). Radio 16 (sm) or 20 (md), 8 dot (spacing/2). Card = bordered surface, radius/md, padding 12 by 16; checked gets a primary border and primary-subtle fill. Invalid is a danger ring, no red label. Focus ring 2 focus-ring with a 2 gap on the radio only. Disabled opacity 0.5.

When to use: exactly one option from a short list (2 to 6) with every option visible.
When not to use: several choices (use Checkbox), an immediate on/off (use Switch), a long list (use a select or Dropdown Menu).

Do: give the group an accessible name and each item a label; use card when options need a description; horizontal only for two or three short options.

Accessibility: native radio inputs in a radiogroup; Tab enters once, arrow keys move the selection, Space selects; the whole label or card is the click target; touch area 44 on coarse pointers.
